text:
All four requirements have been implemented:

**R1 (maxsplit)**: Added `maxsplit` parameter to `sliced`, `split_after`, `split_at`, `split_before`, and `split_when`. Each limits the number of splits performed, returning at most `maxsplit+1` elements.

**R2 (keep_separator)**: Added `keep_separator` parameter to `split_at`. When `True`, the delimiter items are included in the resulting chunks.

**R3 (zip_equal + UnequalIterablesError)**: Added `UnequalIterablesError` exception class and `zip_equal` function to `recipes.py`. Both are exported from the main module. `zip_equal` raises `UnequalIterablesError` when input iterables have different lengths.

**R4 (stagger)**: The existing implementation already correctly handles unequal iterable lengths via `zip_offset` / `zip_longest`. No changes needed.

All 389 existing tests pass. All doctests pass after correcting the `split_before` docstring example.
